content: Hessa gish ubbafe koyro hara asas shoobetha woossa, gaannateththa woossanne galata woossa asa ubbas kawotassinne dere ayssizaytas ubbas woossana mala ta nena qofisays.
Hessika Tumu Ayana duussaninne geeshshateth ubban nuni sarotethaninne wogan daana malassa.
Hayssi nuna ashshiza Xoossa achchan lo7onne ufaysizaza.
Izi asi wuri attana malanne tuma erana mala koyees.
Issi Xoossi xalla dees. Qasseka Xoossasinne asas giddon issi giigisiza gaannay dees. Izikka as gidida Yesus Kirstoosa.
Izi bana asa ubbas aaththi immides. Hessika heerakka wodey aadhdhonta izas markatides.
Takka hayssas mishiraachcho yootanas kiitettidade. Qasseka deretas tumu ammano astamare gidada shuumetadis. Hessaka ta wordotonta tumu yootanassa.
Hessa gish attuma asay ubba soon hanqoy bayndanne palamay baynda ba geeshsha kusheta pude dhoqu histidi woossana mala ta koyayis.
Hessathoka macasati bonchora bana shiishshi ekkidi bessiza may7o may7eto, attin ba hu7e daddi ekkidi woykko al7o may7o, worqanne inqu aaththidi walq walq gooppetto.
Gido attin Xoosse woossos giza macasati istas ooththana bessiza lo7o ooson lo7etto.
Macassi co7u gaada kumeththara azazeteth tamaru.
Macassi co7u gaanappe attin iza tamarsana mala woykko adde bolla godatana mala ta koyikke.
Gaasoyka koyro Addamey medhetides; kaallada Hewaana medhetadus.
Qasseka koyro balettiday Addame gidenna. balettada Xoossa wogappe aadhdhiday macasayo.
Gidikkokka macassi ammanoninne siiqon geeshshatethan barka bana haaron minnikko naa yelon attana.
